resources.string: Fill in the fields below to add a computer you want to remotely shut down or turn on. For details, consult your host PC or network administrator.
Open Command Prompt → type getmac (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF)
Open Command Prompt → type ipconfig → look for IPv4 Address (e.g. 192.168.1.42)
Broadcast address of your network (usually your IP with the last number set to 255) (e.g. 192.168.1.255)
